observation.command: PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select email from users where email in ('valuator@consul.dev','verified@consul.dev','unverified@consul.dev') order by email"; echo "=== administrators ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select id, class_name, user_id from administrators"; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select u.email, a.class_name from users u join administrators a on a.user_id=u.id"; echo "=== dev seed: debates/proposals ==="; PGPASSWORD=root psql -h localhost -U root -d consul_development -tAc "select (select count(*) from debates), (select count(*) from proposals), (select count(*) from projekts), (select count(*) from projekt_phases), (select count(*) from settings)"
